chapter: Instruments, own band and the Eureka
title: Eureka funerals, black shirts and band members
summary: Williams recalls his last funeral job, the old uniform of blue suit and black shirt, and Eureka members such as Red, Verrett and manager Willie Wilson.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: But you don't play any more funerals or anything? You don't want to play that now?

I might start playing later. Mm-hmm. Last one I played the record band, we played a better man right here. Took him from out front of town. And I had a black shirt on. I ain't wearing a black shirt since. I haven't wear the shirt since. That's the last one I played.
Was everybody supposed to wear black shirts?
We were all those in black. Blue suit and black shirt.
At fiennals? Yeah.
But they don't do that anymore.
When did they cut that out?
Well, it's been about 16 years since I played with them. Mm-hmm. Well, now they don't play all that. They don't come out like that anymore.
What was Red playing then?
Red was playing the side and trombone.
Oh, yeah.
That fellow who used to play bass, he died.
And Verrett?
Yeah, he died. Brother Willie, he used to play trumpet, but he didn't hardly play in the band. He was manager of the band. Willie, he died too. Willie Wilson?
Yeah, Willie Wilson, yeah. So his main job was to handle the band?
He was manager of the bass band, but he didn't hardly ever play. He could play trumpet, but he didn't play much.
He just didn't care about playing, huh? No, he was sick.
He had his little baby, so he didn't worry about playing. All he would do was get the job. That's all.
Who was in the Eureka then, besides Willie Wilson and Red Carl? And yourself?

I'm trying to think of the name. Paisley was named there then. Paisley was named there then. Paisley was named there. I can't think of it. It's been so long. Didn't slip my remembrance of all that's in it.
I don't remember who was in it then. You remember Lil' Jim used to play bass drum? Who did he play with, man?
I didn't know who Jim played with. I didn't know Jim. I know they had a bass boy playing that drum. Look back at Tom. Tom Oz playing. I didn't know who Jim played with. Yeah, them old days is gone.
